purpose: Test information lost by mean pooling with equal-parameter readouts on all qualified historical Atlas T data
training_groups: all three fitting folds; evaluation i, stop (i+1)%5
inputs: same FP16 frozen ESMC300 residue cache, FP32 operations; same charge descriptors and missing flags
normalization: fit-only per-protein mean-embedding mean/std applied identically to residue values and pooled summaries; charge fit-only median/mean/std
loss: Hellinger squared, inverse duplicate-T row frequency training weights
exposure: retrospective development; no new-C or full-U acceptance
expand_if: Inspect paired fold and subgroup outcomes plus convergence; register bounded attention or sequence-order control only if it can change mechanism or candidate decision
stop: No blind-model claim; report stopped-by-budget fits separately; do not interpret absent statistical significance as equivalence
